hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts via a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, and pays output tokens from another Euler vault — returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard CLAMM pricing. Standard add-liquidity and donations are disabled to prevent unproductive positions.
